build_transformer_decoder_layer: build a Transformer decoder layer using TransformerFactory with a custom TransformerConfig
build_multihead_attention: build a QKNormMultiheadAttention layer with optional RoPE positional encoding via the factory
build_feed_forward_network: build a feed-forward network with SwiGLU or standard activation using the factory
create_transformer_config: create a TransformerConfig dataclass to set dropout, FFN dim, and normalization hyperparameters
build_positional_encoder: build a learned, sinusoidal, or rotary positional encoder using the factory methods
